stories.title: ‘Light therapy without remortgaging the house’: the best LED face masks – tested
stories.summary: A Guardian review assessed LED face masks that claim to reduce fine lines, blemishes and redness. After consulting dermatologists and testing the products, the reviewers selected a new top-rated model while noting that these masks are among the more expensive at-home beauty devices.

stories.title: How GTA started its own moral panic – video
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto became central to a moral panic over graphic video games, but the controversy was initially encouraged by the game’s own studio in 1997 to generate publicity and taboo appeal. Nearly 30 years later, that engineered scandal continues to shape debate around the series as Grand Theft Auto VI approaches.

links.headline: How GTA started its own moral panic – video
